text: 2026-08-03 source-grounded checkpoint: the heterogeneous-HRF review idea exposed one real public-surface gap: ModelBuildSpec could not reach the existing design-level HRF-by-cell capability. That option is now forwarded through the model boundary, with mixed-width lowering and structural DesignColmap provenance covered by JVM/JS tests. S09 is registered as a solver/provenance-only public scenario, while the manifest explicitly does not claim independent end-to-end design truth. Current evidence: design 183/183 JVM+JS, model 21/21 JVM+JS, fit 175/175 JVM and 167/167 JS, 21 manifest entries validated, Mote doctor clean. Remaining roadmap is intentionally open: S06 full modulator scenario, S13 run scope, S18 WLS/external reference, phase-keyed multiphase/DMS, independent mixed-width parity, default temporal convention parity, broader laws, compileAll/testAll release evidence.
